name: Misal pav
description: Sprouted moth beans under a fiery red oil-slicked gravy, with farsan and bread.

ayurveda.note: Ushna in a high degree — matki is warming and the kat is chilli and oil.

histamine.note: Chilli-heavy with a yeasted bun; the sprouts themselves are fine.

nutrition.highlight: the red oil on top is the point
